verdict.rationale: Crossplane is driven entirely through declarative Kubernetes resources: Providers, Configurations, Functions, XRDs and Compositions are all documented. Its homepage says it exposes "declarative APIs that humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on" and calls them "machine-readable". Because it builds on the Kubernetes API, it works with existing Kubernetes tooling and RBAC, so programmatic and agent clients can drive it through a standard documented interface. Missing for 10: an explicit API reference or schema documentation in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automation or AI agents driving it via the API.
